summary: Iteration 14: Verified production configs (domain-aware routing, policy pages, /website redirect, mobile hero). All 12 requested checks pass. Backend public APIs healthy: GET /api/public/rooms (200), GET /api/public/availability?check_in=2026-10-15&check_out=2026-10-16 (200, Double @ LKR 9500). Frontend: GET /refund-policy, /privacy-policy, /terms all return 200 and render correct components with H1 titles. All 3 policy pages contain required hotel details: 'Kreation Hotels Pvt Ltd', 'No.5, Palmyrah Avenue, Colombo 03', '0112 301737', PayHere mention, 30% advance. Refund & Terms both mention check-in 12:30 PM and check-out 11:30 AM. Terms also mentions '5 minutes' hold and '15 rooms'. Each policy page shows the Kreation logo (navbar + footer, 2 imgs) and a 'Back to Home' link that correctly navigates to /. /website correctly redirects (via <Navigate replace>) to clean / URL. Root / renders Website (not CRM) with hero booking bar containing data-testids hero-booking-bar, booking-checkin, booking-checkout, check-availability-btn. Footer shows all 3 policy links. CRM at /dashboard still works with admin/admin123 (dashboard content detected post-login). Mobile viewport (390x844) renders hero + booking bar fitting within viewport width (confirmed via screenshot and bounding box).

issues: Page never reaches networkidle state because the Turnstile widget keeps a long-lived connection to challenges.cloudflare.com open. Not a functional defect (DOMContentLoaded fires normally and all UI renders) but any automated test using wait_until='networkidle' will time out. Consider lazy-loading Turnstile only when the Contact section is in viewport.

action_items: No action required - all 12 requested features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js domain check uses hostname.startsWith('app.') - safe for app.kreationhotels.lk; ensure production DNS/ingress also forwards app.* subdomain traffic to this frontend (currently preview domain hospitality-ops-18.preview.emergentagent.com is correctly treated as non-CRM public site).
Policy pages hardcode logo URL (LOGO_URL constant) - fine for now but consider moving brand assets into a central config.
Turnstile widget still loads eagerly on every page including /refund-policy, /privacy-policy, /terms where it's not needed. Minor perf opportunity.
Pre-existing (from iter13) still open: no idempotency guard on /payhere/notify; booking/hold datetimes mix naive and tz-aware.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public routes are /, /refund-policy, /privacy-policy, /terms. /website -> Navigate replace to /. App.js uses hostname.startsWith('app.') to choose CRM vs Website at root. PolicyPage component (Website.js line 576) wraps all 3 policy components with sticky nav (logo + Back to Home link) and shared Footer. Testids for hero: hero-booking-bar, booking-checkin, booking-checkout, check-availability-btn. When writing Playwright for /, prefer wait_until='domcontentloaded' because Turnstile keeps networkidle from firing.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration.
